transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact bytes exactly as given, parse to JSON, then re-emit as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace (no indentation, no trailing spaces, no newlines). Persist the exact canonical bytes as proposal_canon.json in the run scratch dir, and compute seed as SHA-256(proposal_canon.json); a third party can verify by running sha256sum proposal_canon.json and confirming it equals seedHex. In this harness’s salted census mode, the third party additionally re-derives hProposal as SHA-256(proposal_canon.json) and then re-derives the final seed as SHA-256(hProposal + salt), matching seedHex. (Command shown for mechanical check: sha256sum proposal_canon.json → should reproduce seedHex.)
